$comment: Hand-classified from docs/source/spec.txt §16. This file is the piece a
scanner cannot derive: 'สมชาย ก.' and 'สร้างเวอร์ชันใหม่' are both Thai
strings in the same mockup, and only a person knows one is filler and the
other is a button. A raw text scan reported '105 missing' because it could
not tell them apart.
where:
ui     must appear in messages.ts or a component
seed   a configured label — must appear in libs/prisma/seed.ts, not code
sample mockup filler that must NEVER appear in code; listed so it is
never re-reported as a gap
Match is substring, case-sensitive, against the whole of src/ (ui) or
seed.ts (seed). Keep entries short enough to survive rewording that does
not change meaning.
AMENDMENT, 1 Sep 2026 — the approval queue is not a screen of its own.
หน้าที่ 2: the tabs are now ทั้งหมด / สร้าง / รับเรื่อง / อนุมัติ, one per
way of being involved, so 'คำขอของฉัน' and 'รออนุมัติของฉัน' are gone as
tab names.
หน้าที่ 5: deciding moved onto the request itself, where the approver can
see what they are approving. Kept: ความเห็น, อนุมัติ, and the two
reworded refusals (ไม่อนุมัติ / ส่งกลับให้แก้). Removed: คิวรออนุมัติ,
ดีลเดียวกับ, snapshot, กรณีตีกลับ — wording of a queue that no longer
exists — and **อนุมัติเป็นชุด / รับมอบอำนาจ, which is a real gap**: batch
approval (APV-04) and the delegation banner (APV-03) both still work in
the API and now have no screen. See docs/open-questions.md.
AMENDMENT, 31 Aug 2026 — A1 has no amount ceilings.
Removed: 'ช่วงวงเงิน'. Replaced: 'ลำดับชั้นผู้อนุมัติ' → 'ผู้อนุมัติ'.
A ladder is a list of levels — the head N levels up the chart, or named
groups and the people in them — so there is no band to print and no
'chain of positions' to name. The ladders published with ceilings were
deleted (yarn matrix:clear-legacy), so keeping the words alive in
messages.ts would be vocabulary with nothing behind it. See the declared
amendment in §8 of ctd-foundation-spec.md.
AMENDMENT, 31 Aug 2026 — A2 no longer edits the approval route.
Removed: 'เส้นทางอนุมัติ' and 'ฟิลด์วงเงินที่ใช้คำนวณ'. The route is
edited on A1 alone, and the amount field it named no longer exists: the
approval matrix stopped selecting a tier by amount (see matrix-rules.ts).
Both strings are absent from src/ on purpose, so leaving them here would
report a gap that is the intended state.
